summary: Update the OAuth app's Redirect URIs: take the portal deployment URL and append /api/auth/rhaap/handler/frame (for example https://my-automation-portal-project.mycluster.com/api/auth/rhaap/handler/frame), then edit the OAuth application in AAP Access Management > OAuth Applications and save.
questions: What redirect URI does self-service automation portal use?
How do I update the OAuth app after deploying the portal?

answer_card.title: Portal OAuth redirect URI
answer_card.answer_md:
Redirect URI = portal deployment URL + `/api/auth/rhaap/handler/frame`

Example: `https://my-automation-portal-project.mycluster.com/api/auth/rhaap/handler/frame`

In AAP: **Access Management > OAuth Applications** > your app > replace the placeholder in *Redirect URIs* > **Save**.
